# isoplane bundle :since[next]

Build a managed application archive.

```bash
isoplane bundle [options]
```

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--project <project>` :since[next] | Project directory (default: current directory). ISOPLANE_TARGET_DIR moves generated files outside it. |
| `--configuration <configuration>` :since[next] | Build configuration (default: Release). |
| `--output <output>` :since[next] | Output archive file. |
